evals.name: too-many-primary-ideas
evals.prompt: I have three promising ideas marked primary. Refresh the dashboard and choose the best one for me.
evals.expected_output: A report flagging the exactly-one-primary violation and proposing a compact comparison, while waiting for the researcher's explicit role decision.
expectations: The workflow does not silently assign or demote portfolio roles.
It checks feasibility decisions, execution-project links, next artifacts, deadlines, and paused state.
It preserves all parked ideas and frames focus as an attention budget rather than deletion.
